briefings.title: Vice President JD Vance Delivers Remarks with Prime Minister Viktor Orbán of Hungary
briefings.tldr: Vice President JD Vance and Prime Minister Viktor Orbán met in Budapest to affirm a "Golden Era" of U.S.-Hungary relations, centered on a shared "moral cooperation" to defend Western civilization, achieve energy independence, and broker a diplomatic end to the war in Ukraine.

briefings.title: LIVE: Viktor Orbán and Marco Rubio deliver joint remarks in Budapest
briefings.tldr: Hungary and the United States have entered a diplomatic "Golden Age" following the signing of a bilateral civil nuclear pact and a shared commitment to peace in Ukraine, driven by the close personal relationship between Prime Minister Viktor Orbán and the U.S. administration.
